narrations.narration: open the fridge
pick up the milk bottle from the lower shelf of the door of the fridge by holding it with the left hand from its handle
nouns: lower shelf of door of fridge

narrations.narration: close the fridge
put down the bottle on the counter top next to the hob
pick up a mug from the drainer
lift the lower part of the coffee machine using the left hand
put the mug under the nozzle of the coffee machine
switch on the coffee machine by pressing the button at the top using the left hand with the index finger
move the milk frother across the countertop bringing it closer to the counter edge using the left hand by sliding it across the surface of the countertop
open the cardboard box containing coffee capsules by holding the lid with the left hand pulling it up and keeping the hand to support the lid
pick up a coffee capsule using the right hand from the coffee capsule box by inserting the right hand into the box and picking one capsule
close the cardboard box by releasing its cover with the left hand so it actually closes
open the compartment of coffee capsules in the coffee machine by holding the handle of the coffee machine with the left hand and pulling it up to reveal the compartment

place the coffee capsule inside the compartment of the coffee machine by positioning the hand on top of the compartment with the coffee capsule in hand and releasing the coffee capsule so it falls in place inside the compartment
lock the coffee capsule inside the coffee machine by closing the compartment using the handle in the left hand by pulling it down and so the coffee capsule is locked in place
pick up the milk bottle from the countertop holding it with the right hand from its handle
open the milk bottle by holding the bottle with the right hand, holding the lid with the left hand and rotating the lid counterclockwise with the left hand.

pour milk from the milk bottle into the milk frother by positioning the milk bottle on top of the milk frother and tilting the bottle so water pours into the milk frother. The bottle of milk is being held with the right hand and the milk frother is just supported by its space on the counter top. The left hand is holding the lid of the milk bottle that has just been opened
put the milk bottle on the countertop
close the milk bottle by positioning the lid with the left hand on top of the milk bottle and rotating it clockwise the bottle is standing on the countertop
try to start the milk frother by pressing the button on the outside using the right hand but it doesn't start because the plug is not in the socket
plug the milk frother in the socket by picking up the plug from the countertop positioning it on the socket rightly and pushing in place with the right hand
switch on the socket by pressing the button next to the plug with the right hand index
turn on the milk frother by pressing the button on the outside using the right hand holding the milk frother with the right hand and pressing with the thumb
open the upper cupboard using the left hand holding the handle
pick up a bowl from the second shelf of the cupboard. The bowl is piled on top of another bowl so pick the one at the top
close the cupboard
pick up the milk from the countertop using the left hand
place the bowl on the countertop. The milk bottle had to be moved to place the bowl in its place
open the milk bottle by holding the bottle with the right hand holding the lid of the bottle with the left hand and turning the lid counterclockwise to open it

pour milk from the milk bottle into the empty bowl by tilting the bottle positioned on top of the bowl. The milk bottle is being held from its handle using the right hand, the bowl is on the countertop, the left hand is holding the lid of the bottle that has been opened
close the milk bottle by putting the lid with the left hand and rotating it clockwise the bottle is being held with the right hand from its handle
open the bottle again deciding to pour more milk

pour more milk from the bottle into the bowl by tilting the bottle positioned on top of the bowl. The milk bottle is being held from its handle using the right hand, the bowl is on the countertop, the left hand is holding the lid of the bottle that has been opened.
close the milk bottle by putting the lid with the left hand and rotating it clockwise. The bottle is being held with the right hand from its handle.
open the fridge
put the milk bottle on the lower shelf of the door of the fridge holding the bottle from its handle with the left hand
nouns: lower shelf of door of fridge

narrations.narration: close the fridge
pick up the cereal box from the upper shelf on top of the sink using the right hand pulling it slightly and then letting it drop into the hand
open the box of cereal this action is off screen
press the button on the coffee machine to start brewing coffee

Take a handful of cereal from inside the cardboard box by inserting the right hand inside the bag that is in the box and then shaking the box a little, picking up a handful of cereal from the box using the right hand. The box is being held with the left-hand.
put the cereal into the bowl by positioning the hand filled with cereal on top of the bowl and then opening the grip of the hand so the cereal in the hand falls into the bowl

take another handful of cereal from inside the box by inserting the right hand inside the bag that is in the box and then shaking the box a little, picking up a handful of cereal from the box using the right hand. The box is being held with the left-hand.
put the cereal in the bowl by positioning the hand filled with cereal on top of the bowl and then opening the grip of the hand so the cereal in the hand falls into the bowl
close the inner bag inside the cereal by inserting the hand in the box and folding the bag inside. This action is off screen but you can hear it
close the cereal box by folding both of its flaps at the top using the left hand
put the cereal on the upper shelf on top of the sink using the right hand sliding it in
open the top drawer
pick up a spoon from the cutlery tray of the top drawer
tap the surface of the milk and cereal inside the bowl using the spoon basically ensuring that the cereal is inside the milk so it softens, repeating multiple times
leave the spoon on the bowl, the spoon will be used to eat the cereal
open the box of wooden stirrers using the left hand by unfolding its cover
pick up a wooden stirrer from inside the box using the left hand
close the box of wooden stirrers by releasing its top
move the mug on the countertop getting it closer to the edge and away from the coffee machine by holding the handle with the left hand and sliding slightly on the surface
pick up the milk frother from its base on the countertop using the right hand in doing so the button on it actually gets switched off so by lifting it actually the milk frother is switched off
hit the milk frother twice on the surface of the countertop using the right hand to steady the frothed milk inside it

pour the frothed milk from the milk frother into the mug holding the mug with the left hand while it's resting on the countertop and holding the milk frother with the right hand tilting it positioning it on top of the mug using the right hand
carefully allow the remaining frothed milk to be poured on the mug which is nearly filled by only very slowly tilting the milk frother
put the wooden stirrer inside the mug which contains coffee and frothed milk
position the milk frother under the nozzle of the tap in the sink
open the tap
rinse the milk frother also using the right hand index to scrape its inner surface
close the tap
turn the milk frother upside down to empty the water inside it
open the tap again
rinse the milk frother
close the tap
turn the milk frother upside down to empty the water inside it this action is mostly off screen
put the milk frother back on its base on the countertop using the right hand
dry the hands using the towel on the handrail of the oven by holding it from its edge this action is mostly off-screen
hold the mug with the left hand on the countertop
hold the wooden stirrer which was resting inside the coffee mug
pick up the coffee mug from the countertop

stir the coffee inside the mug mixing the coffee with the frothed milk by rotating the wooden stirrer inside the mug in circular motions clockwise quickly and repeatedly until the coffee is fully mixed with the frothed milk
shake the wooden stirrer on top of the mug to drop any liquid that stuck to it
open the lid of the trash bin
throw the wooden stirrer in the trash bin
close the trash bin
put the mug on the counter top
